name: privacy-shield
description: Span-by-span PII-cleaned overlay maker and egress lock: scan a folder, file, or text, produce an overlay that is the only thing meant to leave the machine, and decide egress by source classification. Regex/lexicon floor plus an optional local embedding/LLM layer; the value<->placeholder map stays local; every decision is audited. Works standalone with zero loomground and zero RVND; RVND enforcement is an optional skin.
